title: Structural Hierarchy of Reid Class of non-Archimedean Banach Spaces
summary: Let $k$ be a complete valuation field. We formulate a class $\mathscr{R}$ of Banach $k$-vector spaces analogous to Reid class of Abelian groups. We formulate an analogue of the hierarchy of Reid class introduced by K.\ Eda, and verify a counterpart of the classification theorem of Reid class by K.\ Eda.
